_about: Verified provenance inventory for backend/knowledge/documents. Fields ending in _in_text are quoted verbatim from the PDF text extracted by pypdf 6.20.1 and are re-checked by .rag-verify/verify_inventory.py. Fields ending in _iso are this verification's normalisation of the verbatim date for convenience only; they are not strings from the document. Fields ending in _summary are this verification's prose characterisation and are NOT verbatim quotes. Nothing here comes from an external source.

documents.file: 附件1.《大连海事大学本科生创新创业竞赛列表(2026年)》.pdf
documents.title_in_text: 大连海事大学本科生创新创业竞赛列表(2026年)
documents.issuing_body_note: The list itself carries no 发文机关 or 文号 line. The PDF /Author metadata is 'whz' and the producer is PScript5.dll/Acrobat Distiller; neither is evidence of the issuing body.
documents.applicable_scope_summary: 大连海事大学本科生创新创业竞赛 2026 年度认定列表
caveats: PDF text is extracted with Kangxi-radical compatibility ideographs (U+2F24 大, U+2F2F 工, U+2F63 生, ...): 37 distinct characters across 631 occurrences. Fixed by the Phase 2 NFKC repair in backend/knowledge/pdf_loader.py.
The table is extracted column-interleaved: 序号 / 竞赛名称 / 指导单位 / 赛道编号 / 类别 / 校内承办单位 are emitted in separate runs, so a chunk can lose the link between a competition and its 类别 or 承办单位.
Rows whose 类别 cell is empty extract with no category at all, so 'A 类' cannot be derived for those rows from the text alone.

repository_coverage_gaps: No 本科培养方案 or 专业课程计划 document.
No dedicated 考试管理与成绩记载规定 (partially covered by the 学籍管理规定).
No current-year 国家奖学金 / 助学金 通知.
No 大学生创新创业训练计划 (大创) 管理办法.
No 2026 年校内承办竞赛的报名通知或时间表.
The repository stores no source metadata file: the dates, 文号 and issuing bodies above were read out of the PDFs during this verification and are not present in the vector store metadata.
